sources.snippet: After filtering the image set with a multimodal model, we applied an image processing model to classify the remaining images further to improve accuracy. Among the publicly available datasets on smoking, we have used the "smoker and non-smoker" (Khan, 2020 ) for augmented (Shorten and Khoshgoftaar, 2019 ) fine-tuning.
